title: Kenworth K200 heavy duty FUPS custom radar compatible Bumper Bar #125
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS bumper bar Texas style high tensile aluminium channel with lower skirt with provision for 16 LED lights and EBSS safety system. Provision for front mudflaps. Company logo engraved in each end of the bumper . Bumper bar can be custom built to your requirements.
